evidence: Boost logic is 0x1406f9370 (PlayerNav per-frame, called from 0x14076f59a): a burst may start while timer [entry+0xaa0] < duration (0x141ef74a8); on start it sets [9f0]=CD.boostmaxspeed (+0xbc, reflection 0x1406d21c0), [9f4]=accel (0x141ef74a0), fires delegate_BoostOn + event_sound_player_boost; each frame [aa0]+=dt; when not boosting [aa4]+=dt and once [aa4] > cooldown (0x141ef74bc) [aa0] resets to 0 (ready), otherwise it is pinned at duration+eps; failure fires delegate_BoostFailed. Brake (0x1406f9e70 path, mode constant 0x1414dd048=2) sets [a94]=max(0x141ef74c4, 0x141ef74c8*speed), x0.2 (0x1414dd040) when the power check fails. Hand thrusters (0x1406fa4d0) scale the thrust direction by 0x141ef74b0 (one hand) / 0x141ef74b4 (two hands) times save/script multipliers at 0x141e56448..5c (written by 0x1407492a0 from save/upgrade data - deliberately NOT patched). All runtime globals are BSS filled once by 0x14072dd50 (called from engine init 0x14012bd40) from .rdata constants that nothing else reads (full-.text rip-relative scan). NOT verified: exact units; top boost speed stays capped by level data unless the optional patch is used; dinput8 delay-load timing vs the filler (hence both .rdata and .data entries). Only the .rdata source constants are patched: the loader writes them in DllMain, before the engine's tuning filler (0x14072dd50) copies them into the runtime globals at 0x141ef74a0..74c8. Wrist thrusters and push-off: Thrusters: 0x1406fa4d0 does not apply force. It fills a seek mover at entry+0xa50 (+0xa68 max speed = length of the thrust vector, +0xa6c accel) and calls 0x14111cc30, so 0x141ef74b0/b4 (sources 0x1414dd008/0c) are top speeds and 0x141ef74b8 (source 0x1414dd010) is acceleration. Timers +0xaa8/+0xaac limit at 100000 s, so no real time limit; thrust halves (0x1414dd030) only if power <= cost. Same mover type: boost +0x9d8, brake +0xa78, stick flight +0xa00/+0xa28 (fixed cap 4, accel 3 at 0x141e56478). Push-off: nav CD pushmaxspeed +0xb8 (reflection 0x1406d2479) copied to entry+0xdb8 at 0x14072547c; read only at 0x140770103 (0x14076fc60: clamps velocity relative to the grabbed surface, writes +0x710 at 0x140770242, zeroes below 0.225) and 0x1407624e2 (0x140761aa0: after physics, xmm6-8 old velocity, xmm15 dt [rax+0x3c]). 4.0 at 0x1414dcb3c is a .rdata constant no patch touches; 0x1414dcf70 readers are only those two sites.
risk: Value-only changes, no code. Player-only tuning (no other readers). Not saved. The .data writes are aligned float stores (live-safe), but the GUI treats this switch as next-launch. x2 brake may feel abrupt; x1.5 hand thrusters. The optional uncapped boost can reach very high speeds -> impact deaths without god mode. Launch-only; patches rewrite per-frame code. pushmaxspeed's real value is in game packages and unknown, so resulting speed is unmeasured. The cap also limits bad hand-tracking jumps, so a tracking glitch can now launch Jack up to 4x faster and may tunnel thin colliders; continuous collision was not verified. Impact deaths need god mode. 0x1414dd518 has a second reader 0x1407621a1 (see report). Not saved.
